prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: panoramic restaurant website hero photograph, landscape ratio about 2.4:1. High-end food editorial, photorealistic, not a website mockup.
Scene: a richly textured dark charcoal and deep forest-green stone restaurant table, with warm subtle champagne highlights. Three beautiful artisanal plates are partially arranged along the outer edges: refined grilled steak and vegetables near the lower right, a ceramic bowl of noodles near the upper right, and an inviting rice-and-greens dish near the far left. Natural linen touches and dark cutlery are sparse and elegant.
Composition: cinematic overhead/oblique still life with a broad uncluttered dark central area and dark left-center area for large website typography; food remains attractive around edges, never piled in the central text area. Wide panoramic framing, expensive understated restaurant photography, warm directional light, appetizing realistic ingredients and handmade ceramic textures. Rich contrast without crushing food detail. This is general atmosphere artwork, not a specific restaurant photograph.
Constraints: no text, words, labels, logos, people, hands, user interface, gold glitter, or watermark. A single cohesive photograph, no grid, no collage borders.
